core_obligations: 把 A 写成其有限型 F_p-子代数的滤过余极限，用有限逼近引理把 Y→Z 下降为有限的 Y_i→Z_i。
取满射 F_p[x_1,…,x_n]→A_i，把 Z_i 闭浸入 X_i=A^n，并用泛性质造出使右方块笛卡儿的交换图。
把问题归约到仿射空间支配引理，再沿 X→X_i 基变换回 X 完成单射性。
difficulty_reason: H2: Closed immersions of connected affine Fp-schemes induce injective etale fundamental-group maps, with the actual finite-cover domination core included. Given standard etale lifting, polynomial integrality and finite-presentation/Galois-category facts, the author lowers the non-finiteness generator invariant by changing coordinates by p-th-power terms: differentials stay unchanged, the prescribed closed-fibre quotient is preserved, and one more generator becomes integral. Iteration yields a finite etale cover containing the prescribed cover as a clopen fibre piece; the final affine approximation proves injectivity. This mandatory native core is part of the counted proof, not hidden as an assumed prerequisite. No larger K(pi,1) theorem is claimed.

original_difficulty_reason: 特征 p 的连通仿射概形的闭浸入诱导基本群的单射。证明自己搭了两级逼近：先把 Z 的坐标环 A 写成其有限型 F_p-子代数的滤过余极限，用有限逼近引理把有限 étale 的 Y→Z 沿层下降到某个有限的 Y_i→Z_i（Y=Z×_{Z_i}Y_i）；再取满射 F_p[x_1,…,x_n]→A_i 把 Z_i 闭浸入仿射空间 X_i，用多项式代数的泛性质与 R→A 的满性造出交换图，其右方块笛卡儿，于是问题归约为「Y_i 是某个有限 étale U_i→X_i 沿 Z_i 的原像的开闭子概形」，再调用仿射空间支配引理并对 X→X_i 做基变换回到 X。难点在于把无界（无限型）的坐标环用有限型逼近降下来，以及刻意把 Z_i 塞进仿射空间以便套用支配引理；这条两级逼近不是标准先修的直接推论。
